name: Iruka No. 2
source:
Real name: [spoiler]海野 悠太 Umino Yuuta[/spoiler]
Likes: fantasy worlds, animation in general, chicken nanban
Skill: airsoft shooting
Role: planner

[url=/c62009]Owari[/url]'s friend since their college days. He is responsible for planning, scenario and setting. Co-founded Judgement 7 with Owari. A hardcore setting otaku, he wilfully creates settings that are so complex and strange that the average person would never understand them. Often lets out odd shrieks during work, which has earned him the nickname "kiseichuu".

[Translated from [url=http://oreowa.jp/character/iruka.html]the official site[/url]]
